title: D2P Size System
description: Artifact content (artifactType 'd2p:size-system'): a controlled mapping from size labels to a specific set of body measurement values, issued by a market, norm, brand or as synthetic data. A size is resolvable only as sizeSystemRef (pinned revision) plus sizeKey; a label alone is never a reference. Different issuers may interpret the same label differently.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 sections 2, 3 and 5). Not schema-enforced: unique sizeKey values (D2P-REF-005); definitionIds resolve via definitionRegistries (D2P-REF-008); units match definition dimensions (D2P-SEM-070).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

artifactId.description: ID of the artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision this content is.

name.description: Human-readable name of the size system.

definitionRegistries.description: Pinned measurement-definition registries (id and version) against which the definitionIds of this document resolve.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1 (excluding contentDigest itself).

sizeEntry.title: Size entry
sizeEntry.description: One size of the system (element type 'd2p:size-entry').

sizeKey.description: Stable key of the size, unique within the size system. Together with the pinned size-system revision it is the only way to reference the size.

label.description: Display label of the size (e.g. 'M', '40', '122'). Informative only; never used as a reference.

ordinal.description: Position of the size in the system's size order (smaller ordinal = earlier in the order).

measurements.description: Body measurement values assigned to this size. May be empty when the issuer assigns none. Values use body definitions (kind 'body', D2P-SEM-075); a definitionId appears at most once per size entry (D2P-REF-005).

sizeIssuer.title: Size issuer
sizeIssuer.description: The issuer of a size system.

kind.description: 'market' (a market convention), 'norm' (a published sizing standard), 'brand' (a manufacturer's own system), 'synthetic' (test data, not a real size table).

name.description: Name of the issuer or convention.
